verdict.rationale: Muse documents its own computer with a file system and terminal where it writes and runs its own code (muse-docs-1, muse-docs-7). Users can put files into the VM and download anything Muse generates (muse-supp-vm-files-export), and it builds data dashboards such as spending trackers and sleep-pattern dashboards (muse-docs-16). That covers code execution on user data and downloadable outputs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of chart/plot generation and computed analytical answers (only implied via dashboards), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the code-execution workflow.
